objective: Refresh the Park MVP delivery controls and correct stale installation/user documentation. Define a truthful two-lane demonstration scope and measurable acceptance gates without changing runtime behavior or the frozen scientific baseline.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Park MVP is the primary product delivery track under Issue #158.
DR24 application integration is tracked by Issue #253; PR #264 is a raw-only adapter and remains Draft.
The v0.2.0 scientific baseline, 42-feature contract, class order, benchmark and v1.0.1 software release remain immutable.
CPVS exact reconstruction remains a separate unresolved scientific blocker.
Ordinary CI does not establish source-backed scientific validation.

baseline.description: Documentation-only delivery-control update based on current repository state and Issue #158/#253 plus PR #264. No runtime, model, data, benchmark, feature schema, taxonomy, or scientific threshold changes.

correctness.before: Quick Start, User Guide, Installation, and product roadmap contained stale v1.0.0/v1.0.1 statements or an obsolete 2026-10-11 roadmap.
correctness.after: Updated documentation to v1.0.1 and stated the current distinction between frozen baseline inference and raw DR24 exploratory acquisition.

reliability.reason: This change is documentation-only. It does not implement or test the DR24 runtime path.

reproducibility.before: The Park MVP acceptance scope and staged demonstration gates were spread across issues and audit notes.
reproducibility.after: Added a dated delivery plan with explicit gates G0–G8, source/identity/QC rules, two separate analysis lanes, and required reproducibility artifacts.

scientific_validity.reason: No new scientific data acquisition, model evaluation, calibration, anomaly evaluation, or source-backed validation was performed.

regression_protection_count.reason: No runtime code or tests changed.

measurement.trade_off: Prioritize accurate Park acceptance criteria and removal of misleading documentation over adding unsupported completion claims.

evidence: Inspected current Issue #158, Issue #253, PR #264 and the current Park readiness audit.
Added docs/PARK_MVP_DELIVERY_PLAN_2026-11-05.md with two separate scientific lanes and explicit acceptance gates.
Confirmed the frozen v0.2.0 baseline and 42-feature contract remain unchanged by this documentation-only branch.

CI on this PR initially failed the cumulative lifecycle gate because the required cycle record was missing; a matching machine-readable record is now being added. Final CI must be rerun and inspected.
No model, feature schema, benchmark, taxonomy, scientific threshold, data artifact, or release was changed.

root_causes: Documentation drift caused the user guide and quick start to describe v1.0.0 after v1.0.1 had been released.
The prior roadmap date and completion claims did not describe the current Park MVP delivery state.
unresolved: DR24 source-selectable application integration is not complete.
No 5–10 object source-backed Workbench smoke test has been verified.
No 30–50 object guided demonstration or complete Park handover package has been verified.
The frozen production model artifact is not present in the GitHub package release and requires controlled local verification.

findings: The first Park demonstration must distinguish raw DR24 exploratory analysis from frozen v0.2.0 reference inference.
Native DR24 data must not be fed to the frozen v0.2.0 model without a validated feature mapping.
A 5–10 object smoke test is required before the 30–50 object guided demonstration.
CPVS and CIN runtime must remain outside the Park MVP critical path.
Do not report a completion percentage without a defined method and current evidence.

open_blockers: Documentation-only change; automated tests do not validate runtime DR24 acquisition or Workbench behavior.
Final CI and cumulative lifecycle gate must pass on the final PR head.
Source-backed smoke-test and guided-demo evidence remain absent.

knowledge_carried_forward: Keep the v0.2.0 baseline and v1.0.1 release immutable.
Complete a bounded raw DR24 application path and 5–10 object smoke test before expanding to 30–50 objects.
Keep CPVS #170 unresolved and separate from Park delivery.
Do not claim a DR24 classifier, scientific performance, or Park acceptance without matching evidence.
